_how: Copy to validation_rules.json and complete it from your Lab 2 paper design. Rule types: day3/rules/RULE_TYPES.md. Every rule needs id, type, reason, on_fail and a one-line why.
_todo: ticket_number: format (3-digit prefix, hyphen, 10 digits) and prefix belongs to the airline
airline_code: format (2 characters; digits are allowed, e.g. 6E)
fare_class: format and in the published list
od_pair: format, both airports known, origin different from destination
fare break: fare_amount max 2 decimal places and above 0; currency in the accepted list
issue_date: ISO format, not after the file's business date, late after 30 days (route it: quarantine or flag?)
required: which other fields can never be empty?

file_rules.why: A renamed or missing column breaks every rule after it: reject the whole file.

rules.why: No booking or ticket id means nothing to settle or trace.
We only settle airlines we have a contract for.
Same ticket twice in one file: keep the first, skip and count the repeat.
